test/fixtures/views/boolean-property.html:1 <button data-event="add" data-bind-disabled="flag"> data-bind-disabled: "flag" is string (expected boolean — disabled is set with Boolean(value), so "false" would be true)
test/fixtures/views/each-invalid-key.html:1 <template data-each="rows" data-key="uid"> data-key: "uid" is not a field of rows's items (expected one of: done, id, label)
test/fixtures/views/each-missing-field.html:1 <li data-text="name"> data-text: "name" is not a field of rows's items (expected one of: done, id, label)
test/fixtures/views/each-missing-key.html:1 <template data-each="rows"> data-key: data-each="rows" has no data-key (expected data-key naming an item field)
test/fixtures/views/each-missing-list.html:1 <template data-each="items" data-key="id"> data-each: "items" is not in the view contract (expected one of: busy, count, flag, rows, title)
test/fixtures/views/each-nested.html:1 <template data-each="rows" data-key="id"> data-each: data-each="rows" is nested in another data-each; list items are flat (expected a top-level list)
test/fixtures/views/event-scope.html:1 <button data-event="remove"> data-event: "remove" must be sent from a row of rows (expected inside data-each="rows")
test/fixtures/views/event-scope.html:2 <button data-event="add"> data-event: "add" is sent from a rows row, so it carries a key the engine does not expect (expected outside any data-each)
test/fixtures/views/event-value.html:1 <button data-event="rename"> data-event: "rename" expects a value, but <button> sends none (expected an input, select or textarea)
test/fixtures/views/if-kind.html:1 <template data-if="count"> data-if: "count" is number (expected boolean — data-if shows its content when the value is true)
test/fixtures/views/list-as-scalar.html:1 <p data-text="rows"> data-text: "rows" is list (expected a string, number, boolean or scalar, not a list)
test/fixtures/views/misplaced.html:1 <div data-if="busy"> data-if: data-if is only supported on <template> (expected <template>)
test/fixtures/views/misplaced.html:2 <ul data-each="rows" data-key="id"> data-each: data-each is only supported on <template> (expected <template>)
test/fixtures/views/missing-bind.html:1 <button data-event="add" data-bind-disabled="bussy"> data-bind-disabled: "bussy" is not in the view contract (expected one of: busy, count, flag, rows, title)
test/fixtures/views/missing-text.html:1 <h1 data-text="titel"> data-text: "titel" is not in the view contract (expected one of: busy, count, flag, rows, title)
test/fixtures/views/trigger-without-event.html:1 <div data-on="click"> data-on: data-on without data-event does nothing (expected data-event on the same element)
test/fixtures/views/unknown-event.html:1 <button data-event="delete"> data-event: "delete" is not an event the engine accepts (expected one of: add, remove, rename)
